title: LangGraph KeyError: when embedding a compiled subgraph node in a parent graph workflow
observed_behavior: A compiled scheduler-assistant subgraph is registered in a parent graph as node 'scheduler_assistant', and a conditional edge from START can route to it. During execution/streaming LangGraph raises KeyError: 'scheduler_assistant' inside its routing (the traceback mentions the __start__ task and the scheduler_assistant task).
structure_focus: Compiled subgraph registered as a parent node and targeted from a START conditional edge; node-name/routing consistency
notes: Stack Overflow question with no answers (0 answers at fetch time); the failure is unresolved and the post only gives a minimal structure rather than full code. The fixture reconstructs that structure: a compiled child node plus entry node, and a START conditional edge whose path map includes the scheduler node. It may not reproduce the KeyError on current versions; the case is classified user_graph because the likely cause is node registration/routing wiring (a name or subgraph wiring error) rather than a confirmed framework defect. The post's version is inconsistent (0.5.x vs 0.6.7), which further limits confidence.
